name: Pavilion Gardens Play Area
description: Two outdoor play spaces in Buxton's Pavilion Gardens, open all year: a children's play area for younger ones with things to climb, hide in, crawl through and slide down, and an activity park for older children with swings, slides and climbing frames, next to a five-piece outdoor gym and a small ball court. There's also toddler soft play in the Pavilion Kitchen from 9.30am daily, and a miniature train.
